# PhDRadar

> Funded PhD and postdoc opportunities abroad, curated for students from mainland China. Every item was checked against its official page and carries the sentence seen there; items are removed after their deadline. Updated daily (last: 2026-10-21).

Read the JSON files below rather than scraping the HTML page. All endpoints are static, read-only and need no key.

## Data
- [API directory](https://pingfanfan.github.io/PhDRadar/api/v1/index.json): counts, endpoints, field notes and usage rules
- [Opportunities open now](https://pingfanfan.github.io/PhDRadar/api/v1/opportunities.json): 3542 items — postings and programmes with deadline, funding, eligibility for mainland Chinese applicants, evidence quote, and requirement fields quoted from the posting
- [Verified sources](https://pingfanfan.github.io/PhDRadar/api/v1/sources.json): 3968 scholarship schemes, doctoral programmes and job boards
- [JSON Schema](https://pingfanfan.github.io/PhDRadar/api/v1/schema.json) and [OpenAPI](https://pingfanfan.github.io/PhDRadar/api/openapi.json)
- [RSS feeds](https://pingfanfan.github.io/PhDRadar/feeds/): new opportunities by discipline and region

## Rules for agents
- Every opportunity was checked against its official page; evidence_quote is the sentence seen there. Cite it, and send users to url to confirm before applying.
- Do not infer eligibility: cn_eligible 'check' means the official page does not say whether applicants from mainland China can apply.
- Deadlines are as stated on the official page; time zones are not normalised. Items disappear from opportunities.json after their deadline.
- Agents may draft materials, but the applicant reviews and submits every application personally. No automated mass submission.
- Data licence: CC BY 4.0. Attribute PhDRadar and link to the official page.
